foco.notaMax:
Up to 999999 steps. Set it to your focuser's real travel
so it is not driven into its end stop.
avz.intro: TMC2209 driver parameters. Applied on save, no reboot needed.
avz.notaCorriente: Start low (300-400) and raise only as needed: too much and the motor and driver run hot.
avz.notaSensibilidad: 0 = disabled.  1-255: the higher, the less force needed to trip.
avz.notaVelMinima: Steps/s below which StallGuard is ignored (below that the reading is noise).
avz.explicacion:
Usable sensitivity depends on the microstepping, which is why each product ships different.
At 32 microsteps (focuser) SG_RESULT stays at 2 with the motor unloaded: there is no headroom
to tell a real stall apart and detection only yields false positives, so the sensible choice
there is to leave it at 0 and rely on the software limits. At 8 microsteps (rotator) it does
work: measured on the assembled unit, sensitivity 16 with a 300 steps/s minimum speed at
800 mA catches the hard stop without tripping on its own. The three go together: the high
minimum speed is what allows such a high sensitivity. Change one, revisit the others.
avz.notaFabrica:
Erases the whole device configuration, WiFi networks included,
and reboots it with the default values.
avz.confirmarFabrica:
This erases the whole device configuration, including the saved WiFi networks. After rebooting it will bring up its own access point and you will have to set them up again.

Continue?
avz.reiniciandoFabrica: Configuration erased. The device is rebooting; connect again.
wifi.apTitulo: Own access point (used when it cannot join any network)
wifi.nota:
WiFi changes only take effect at boot, so the device is rebooted
on save. An empty AP password leaves the network open; WPA2
requires at least 8 characters. With WiFi disabled the device boots faster
and is USB-only; holding the encoder button at power-on still starts the AP.
wifi.reiniciando: Saved. The device is rebooting; connect again.
wifi.passCorta:
The access point password must be 8 characters or longer,
or empty (open network). Shorter than that and the device ignores it.
msg.fabricaHecho: Configuration erased. The device is starting with factory defaults.
msg.fabricaFallo: The device did not confirm the reset, so nothing was changed. Most likely its firmware is older than this feature.
rot.notaPasosPorGrado:
Depends on your gearbox. If the angle shown does not match the real one,
this is the value to correct.
msg.modoIncorrecto: The device booted in the other mode. Check the mode jumper.
avz.notaCorrienteHold:
What the motor holds almost all the time, so it is what drives the heat.
0 = no holding torque (shaft runs free). Too little and the weight can back-drive it.
